tozo - ai translation wireless noise can.description: TOZO NC9 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Bluetooth 5.3 in-ear earbuds feature 45dB hybrid ANC to eliminate external distractions and a practical Transparency Mode to let in ambient sound for safe outdoor activities. Equipped with 10mm drivers, OrigX Acoustic 2.0 and Bass+ Acoustics technology, they deliver deep punchy bass, balanced detailed stereo sound, and low-latency performance for synchronized gaming and video playback. Built with six-mic ENC call noise reduction, the earbuds effectively filter background noise to ensure crystal-clear calls and online meetings in noisy environments. Designed with an ergonomic fit and six sizes of replaceable ear tips, they provide secure, pressure-free all-day comfort for long wear. Customize your audio via the TOZO App with 32 EQ options, adjustable noise control modes, global EQ sharing and smart firmware updates. The earbuds feature IPX8 nano-coated waterproof protection to resist sweat, rain and splashes for daily workouts and active use. Stable Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity offers reliable signal transmission within 15 meters, while the 60-hour total battery life and intuitive LED power display deliver long-lasting usage. Additionally, the TOZO App integrates powerful free AI functions monthly, including 30 minutes of real-time and simultaneous translation, 60 minutes of AI voice chat, and 60 minutes of meeting recording, plus unlimited access to text chat, image-to-text conversion, wording proofreading, text simplification and content enrichment tools. Perfect for commuting, travel, remote work, outdoor sports and daily entertainment.
